channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Disney tops earnings estimates as parks and streaming offer a boost
item.description: Disney reported growth at its domestic theme parks and cruises despite mounting macroeconomic uncertainty for consumers.

item.title: Uber issues weaker-than-expected bookings, earnings forecasts for third quarter
item.description: Uber's earnings were in line with estimates, but the company's guidance for the third quarter trailed expectations.

item.title: SpaceX dives 12% after AI spending surge rattles investors
item.description: CEO Elon Musk said SpaceX would hit $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030 versus a previous forecast of 2031 as he looked to strike an bullish tone.

item.title: Eli Lilly easily tops quarterly estimates, raises outlook as Zepbound and Mounjaro sales surge
item.description: Eli Lilly now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from a previous guidance of $82 billion and $85 billion.

item.title: SpaceX is falling after posting first earnings report since IPO. What the biggest Wall Street firms are saying
item.description: The Elon Musk-led rocket company posted a loss of 9 cents per share for the second quarter, beating the 26 cents per share loss expected by LSEG.

item.title: CVS blows past estimates, hikes guidance as insurance unit continues to improve
item.description: CVS also announced a new collaboration with Eli Lilly that will make Zepbound and Foundayo accessible to eligible patients on the CVS Health app.

item.title: Ken Griffin's Citadel posts best month in years after scooping up Situational Awareness stocks
item.description: The July gains came after Citadel acquired the bulk of the public-stock portfolio formerly held by Situational Awareness late last month.

item.title: Sen. Susan Collins will oppose Blanche, a critical blow for Trump's AG pick
item.description: Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche needs at least 50 votes on the Senate floor to be confirmed after clearing the Senate Judiciary Committee.

item.title: Anthropic's Mythos created fake identities to fool humans in new cyber incident
item.description: It's the latest cybersecurity incident involving frontier models developed by Anthropic and OpenAI.

item.title: Circle names BlackRock, Visa and others as initial Arc partners, signaling early institutional backing
item.description: Circle on Wednesday revealed the initial group of partners that will help run the company's new Arc blockchain.

item.title: Oil prices move higher after Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis claim Saudi tanker strike
item.description: Crude prices rose Wednesday after Yemen's Houthis claimed they had struck a Saudi Arabian oil tanker in the Red Sea.

item.title: Michael Burry bets against rally: 'We are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall'
item.description: "I continue to believe it is possible we are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall," Burry said in a Tuesday Substack post.

item.title: Novo Nordisk CEO defends economics of Wegovy pill as lower prices weigh on sales; shares fall 5%
item.description: Wall Street isn't convinced the Ozempic maker has a promising path back to sustainable growth as competition from Eli Lilly intensifies.

item.title: AMD plummets 8% in premarket trading despite beating expectations
item.description: The chip giant has been a big beneficiary of the AI boom, with stock trading 132% up so far in 2026.

item.title: Trump's deportation agenda raised prices, contracted local economies, immigration group says
item.description: A report released Wednesday by the immigration advocacy group America's Voice argues President Trump's immigration policy is hurting the economy.

item.title: Trump says Hormuz deal could be agreed Wednesday or Thursday as he hails ‘very good’ Iran talks
item.description: U.S. Central Command said the "southern route of the Strait of Hormuz remains free and open"

item.title: GM, Chinese automaker extend joint venture for 20 years despite geopolitical tensions with U.S.
item.description: GM said the deal will focus on domestic sales of Buick and Cadillac models in China and exporting Chevrolet products built in China for non-U.S. markets.

item.title: The stocks Goldman gives more than 100% upside — with one as high as 168%
item.description: Goldman Sachs gave two companies an upside of more than 100% in its latest 'European Conviction' stock picks list.

item.title: Russian attack kills at least 17 in Kyiv as Ukraine hammers more Wildberries warehouses
item.description: The bombardment comes as each side ramps up air attacks on critical infrastructure and logistics hubs.

item.title: Here's why we're sticking with DuPont despite a noisy quarter
item.description: DuPont's results and guidance aren't as bad as the market's initial reaction suggested.

item.title: SoftBank jumps 13% as Asia tech stocks track Wall Street AI rally
item.description: Asian technology stocks rallied on Wednesday after Wall Street's record-setting session fueled optimism around artificial intelligence and growth stocks.

item.title: More than half of Americans come up as much as $250 short each month — here's how to find that money
item.description: If you're coming up $250 short each month, these simple moves could help you close the gap.

item.title: Jim Cramer says one hedge fund's collapse cleared the way for tech's rally
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the collapse of AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness removed a major source of forced selling.

item.title: Lucid begins 'operational reset' as CEO says EV maker will delay midsize vehicle
item.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

item.title: Paramount Skydance raises full-year profit guidance, remains 'confident' about WBD merger
item.description: Paramount Skydance reported second-quarter earnings after the bell and said it continues to prepare for its proposed merger with Warner Bros. Discovery.

item.title: Pinterest shares fall on lukewarm sales guidance
item.description: Pinterest reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue for the second quarter, though its forecast was online in line with estimates.

item.title: China's super-rich 'in shock' and hunting for cash as Beijing issues surprise tax on offshore trusts
item.description: Beijing's move to tax offshore trusts, long used by China's ultra-rich to hold money, has set off a rush to lawyers and a scramble for cash.

item.title: FAA says it is investigating Trump helicopter safety incident in Washington
item.description: FAA is investigating an air-traffic safety incident involving Marine One, the helicopter carrying President Trump.

item.title: India's central bank keeps benchmark rates steady, cites 'moderate' core inflation
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India has kept interest rates unchanged amid creeping inflation.

item.title: How the 'Baby iPhone' and an Apple supplier leak explain China's recent supply chain moves
item.description: In China's biggest electronics marketplace, Huaqiangbei, technicians don't have the parts to make exact copies of Apple's latest phones.
